array.string: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; CONF="$HOME/.cache/business-lens/playlist.conf"; [ -f "$CONF" ] && eval "$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(export )?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' "$CONF")" && grep -E '^https?://' "$CONF" | while read -r u; do "$HOME/.pi/agent/skills/business-lens/scripts/yt-search.sh" sync "$u"; done
